description: Governor's office North Central Province - Appointed Administrative Service Officers of North Central Provincial Council S. M. S. Bandusena and 15 other appointments
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists specific personnel appointments (named individuals) to various administrative positions within the North Central Provincial Council. It provides the names of the appointees and their new titles (e.g., "Secretary of the Ministry," "Deputy Chief Secretary," "Land Commissioner") but does not include any detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
